lawLevelReference.description: A world's Law Level controls possession and enforcement. The numbered ladder is cumulative: an item remains restricted at every higher Law Level after its first listed threshold.

legalCategoryReference.contextNotice: Nearby examples are source-list context only. They do not fill the selected category, classify an item, or determine legality.
legalCategoryReference.description: Legal Category describes the credentials normally needed for lawful possession and supplies modifiers for black-market searches. World Law Level still governs whether an item is legal, and the referee decides how a world classifies it.
legalCategoryReference.filterSemantics: The Legal Category filter is an exact catalog match. It does not infer neighboring categories, local permission, stock, or a final world ruling.
legalCategoryReference.notes: Category examples are illustrative, not exhaustive. The referee decides how a world classifies an item; neighboring examples provide context only and never change an exact catalog classification.
legalCategoryReference.rulesContext: Mongoose Traveller 2E Central Supply Catalogue Legal Categories
legalCategoryReference.undeterminedDescription: No exact source-backed category is assigned. This is not Category 1 and does not mean legal.

techLevelReference.description: Tech Level measures a world's broad scientific and industrial capability and the complexity and effectiveness of technology. A world's value is an average for local production and repair, not a legality rating or a guarantee of stock.
techLevelReference.filterSemantics: A Maximum TL filter includes variants whose safely parsed recorded TL, or the lower bound of a minimum/range expression, is no greater than the selected value. It is a catalog technology cutoff, not a guaranteed shopping list for a world at that TL.

armour.description: The listed TL is the technology needed to manufacture this armour variant. It does not itself determine Protection or legality, and local stock and access can vary.

augment.description: The listed TL identifies the technology of this augmentation variant. Medical care below the highest relevant implant TL can make long-term treatment or surgery more difficult.

equipment.description: The listed TL is the source-recorded technology rating for this equipment variant. It commonly marks manufacture or availability, while computers, vehicles, robots, and exact item rules can define a different role.

weapon.description: The listed TL is when this weapon variant first appears. It would generally be unusual on a lower-TL world, although exceptional access can exist.

higherLevels.summary: The Core scale describes no separate general milestones above TL15 and states that higher levels have no theoretical upper limit. Use the exact item's source for its capabilities.
higherLevels.title: Technology beyond the standard Imperial scale

techLevelReference.notes: The Core provides one societal TL scale, not separate weapon, armour, augment, and equipment ladders. The kind guidance explains how to read an item's recorded TL without treating it as legality or guaranteed availability.

techLevelReference.unknownDescription: No usable Tech Level is structured for this variant. Unknown is not TL0 and does not establish local manufacture, availability, or legality.
